errors.text_span: 沿顺时针方向，紧接着是浅灰色的“状态”切片，占比20%；随后是中灰色的“属性”切片，占比16%；最后是黑色的“要素”切片，占比14%
errors.evidence: The description of the slice order is incorrect. Starting from the largest slice, "行为" (50%), the next slice in the clockwise direction is "要素" (14%), not "状态" (20%). The slices are actually arranged in descending order of size in a counter-clockwise direction.

errors.text_span: 从整体视觉布局来看，各个切片沿顺时针方向严格按照比例大小呈递减顺序依次排列。
errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly summarizes the chart's layout. The slices are arranged in descending order of size (50%, 20%, 16%, 14%), but in a counter-clockwise direction, not a clockwise one.
